description: Returns opportunities similar in meaning to a given one, each with a similarityScore from 0 to 1 and a short matchExplanation of shared signals (category, geography, organization, award size). Inputs: opportunity_id (the id field of a result) and limit. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Counts toward the search allowance.

limit.description: Max similar opportunities to return (default: 5, max: 20)

opportunity_id.description: ID of the opportunity to find similar matches for (from search results)

name: find_similar
title: Find Similar Opportunities
